story.fullStory:
Howlin Wolf's "Smokestack Lightning" — original release 1956. "Smokestack Lightning" (also "Smoke Stack Lightning" or "Smokestack Lightnin'") is a blues song recorded by Howlin' Wolf in 1956.

It became one of his most popular and influential songs.

It is based on earlier blues songs, and numerous artists later interpreted it.
